rows.Origin:
Bred by G. Delbard (France, 2004).
Introduced in France by Delbard/Georges Delbard SA in 2011 as 'Pink Paradise'.
Introduced in United States by Certified Nurseries in 2020 as 'Julie Andrews'.
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2021 as 'Pink Paradise'.
rows.Bloom: Pink, golden-yellow undertones. Strong, anise, rose, spice fragrance. up to 30 petals. Average diameter 3.5". Large, full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, upright. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 32" (up to 80cm). Width: up to 2' (up to 60cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: See also 02.4800.102, which Le Roeulx Trials list as 'Pink Paradise' (error)
